ev.q: 76.0% of women aged 50–74 years reported that they had a mammogram within the preceding 2 years
The percentage of women who had a mammogram within the preceding 2 years increased with family income
Percentage* of Women Aged 50–74 Years Who Had a Mammogram Within the Preceding 2 Years
from 67.7% of women with family income <200% of FPL, to 74.3% of women with income 200% to <400% of FPL, and 81.5% of those with income ≥400% of FPL
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
Family income was imputed when missing.
